meaning: A home with things like lights, locks, and thermostats that connect to the internet, so you can control them from your phone.
clues: It is about everyday things in a house, but with some computer help.
Lights, locks, thermostats, and cameras can all be run from your phone.
You can switch things on or off from another room, or from far away.
Some follow a timer, like lights that turn on at dusk.
It has two words. The first starts with S and means clever.
assumes: A smartwatch is worn on your wrist
An alarm system warns of break-ins
A remote control works from across the room

decoys.meaning: A watch you wear that shows messages and tracks your steps.
A set of sensors and a loud siren that warn of a break-in.
A handheld device that controls a TV or other gadget from across the room.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, "automatic" meant a timer that switched on the porch light.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Now your phone does it from anywhere. Tip: give each device its own strong password and keep its updates on.

sources.name: FTC, Securing Your Internet-Connected Devices at Home
